notes.title: Release Temporarily Postponed
notes.content: [h1][b]Happy Friday the 13th everyone![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024132/90d5dac93b28db7960235f139733b6a66e5ff27b.png"][/img][/p][p]We had planned on releasing today and as we were preparing the launch build we ran into some game breaking bugs and despite our best efforts to get them fixed asap we need to postpone the launch till we can get them shored up.[/p][p][/p][p]Our goal is to give you the best experience and unfortunately [i]something coming out of the lake last minute[/i] has forced our hand to push it off till we can make sure that we give you the best game we can![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience, please play something extra terrifying while we patch up these cabins.[/p]

tags.bug: we ran into some game breaking bugs
